objective: Measure the ranking increment from Saner with the candidate identities and query cohort held fixed.
evaluation_scope: reference-isolated diagnostic with known pretrained exposure; not clean model-generalization validation
reference_policy: global leave-cohort-identity-out: all active query identities and exact query duplicates removed from reference and analog paths; structural candidate truth retained
control_pipeline: prvsiyan V43; observed comparator, not a single-factor architectural ablation
identity_metric: validation.metric, checked against official CASMI metric V14 using RDKit2026.03.3
acceptance: Every active molecule predicted; no placeholder fill counted as inference.
Every reference index/representative excludes the frozen cohort mask; candidates are not filtered by target labels.
Forward scorers complete covered queries without swallowed failures or budget truncation.
Metric-identity candidate sets exactly equal for V0/V1/CUSTOM; otherwise reject a ranking-only interpretation.
Do not adopt a configuration or infer hidden-test performance from this exposed 48-molecule diagnostic alone.
known_exposure: FPNet full1 was declared trained on all competition training folds including NP examples.
Saner final_model was refit on full data including former validation identities.
Other public checkpoints/ranker rows have component-specific unknown or insufficiently audited membership.
component_experiment: COMP001_FOLD0_SANER_FIXED_CANDIDATES: complete on 32 audited development identities; see its separate record, not a substitute for whole-stack ablation.

flex_result.adoption: Retain variants for further verification. Do not replace the main pipeline or extrapolate hidden performance from this exposed pilot.

v43_result.interpretation: Architecture comparator with known pretrained exposure, not a single-factor ablation or a hidden-test score.

first_attempt_failure: Flex 48-query run reached ICE budget 636.12s with 32/46 covered molecules scored. Final health check rejected the run. Preserve failed artifacts and recover only verified stages.
next_clean_experiment: Use the completed component audit as a limited development result; any broader clean validation requires component-specific retraining or proven untouched identities. Do not label the whole existing pipeline clean.
